# uniq

Published version: `cli/uniq@0.2.7`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Filter adjacent duplicate records for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/uniq@0.2.7 [-cduDiz] [--all-repeated[=METHOD]] [--group[=METHOD]] [-f FIELDS] [-s CHARS] [-w CHARS] [FILE]
```

## Supported scope

Read a file or stdin and compare adjacent records. Sort first for global deduplication; output is written to stdout.

| `--all-repeated` | required | Print all duplicates; none, prepend or separate separators. |
| `--group` | required | Print all groups; separate (default), prepend, append or both. |
| `-u` / `--unique` | none | Print only groups that occur once. |
| `-i` / `--ignore-case` | none | Ignore ASCII case when comparing adjacent records. |
| `-f` / `--skip-fields` | required | Skip fields, then bytes before comparing. Default: `0`. |
| `-s` / `--skip-chars` | required | Skip fields, then bytes before comparing. Default: `0`. |
| `-w` / `--check-chars` | required | Limit compared bytes. |
| `-z` / `--zero-terminated` | none | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `-D` | none | Print all duplicates; none, prepend or separate separators. |

## Argument and exit-status contract

Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Comparison and case folding use C-byte rules.
- --group conflicts with -c/-d/-D/-u; -c conflicts with -D.

## Examples

```sh
printf 'a\na\nb\n' | moonx cli/uniq@0.2.7 -c
moonx cli/uniq@0.2.7 -d sorted.txt
```
